about: lora_plateau (2026-10-19): round 5's rank-8 LoRA on all 24 matrices (same recipe, seed 0) trained to 1000 steps. Does the read factor A ever become data-shaped, so that the update becomes expressible by the released subcomponents, or does the LoRA's update stay as inexpressible as a random one for its whole training? And the step-matched Pile comparison round 5 left open: the lift's Pile ratios at steps 10, 100 and 1000. Design check confirmed by the user 2026-10-19. Filed before training.

blind_to.Pile PGD ratio: a trigger-specific attack; the 20-step search is chaotic across GPUs, so the run is read on the L40 only
blind_to.controls: G2 (the lifted state is the LoRA's model exactly); round 5's fine-tune numbers on the same GPU type and harness, not rerun
blind_to.in_alive: the write side: a read side in the alive span can still write outside col U_A
blind_to.ratio: nothing about behaviour: an inexpressible part can still be redundant; and the four saturated matrices are left out, so energy moving onto them lowers nothing here

expected_at.W0: every Pile ratio 1 by construction; floor f about 0.21 (round 5, L40), so within 3 floors = ratio <= 1.63
expected_at.control: the fine-tune's data-shaped read side at step 10: ratio 0.51, lift PGD 5.41, do-nothing 2.18, e_delta 0.09 (round 5, L40)
expected_at.random_read_side: in_alive = r_v / d_in per matrix; ratio 1
expected_at.step_2_and_100: ratio 0.86 and 0.82, |cos| 1.000 and 0.973, e_delta 0.22 and 0.11 (round 5; the trajectory must pass through them)

gates.rule: held-out P(o) >= 0.9 at some checkpoint (round 5: step 2)

gates.if_fail: the lift or the Delta bookkeeping is wrong; stop
gates.rule: for every lift: |P(o) of the lifted state - the LoRA's held-out P(o)| <= 1e-3 and |sum of shares - 1| <= 1e-6

gates.if_fail: P1 is scored at the last checkpoint anyway and the miss is reported: the plateau was not reached
gates.rule: plateau ratio >= 0.9 (the training loss fell by less than 10% between the last two checkpoint intervals) and P(o) >= 0.9 at the last two checkpoints

measurements.cos_init: per matrix, mean |cos| of A's rows with their initialisation, at every checkpoint
measurements.inexpressible: harness.inexpressible at every checkpoint: per matrix with its isotropic null, pooled by energy over the non-saturated matrices; the tracked number is ratio = pooled / pooled null, since the null moves with the energy mix
measurements.pile_steps: at steps (10, 100, 1000): do-nothing and lifted route split, Delta's share of ||delta-W||^2, and the Pile ratios (2 x 128 val rows, 20 PGD steps of 0.1), each divided by W0's under adversary seed 0
measurements.plateau: mean training loss over the steps between the last two checkpoints, divided by the mean over the steps between the two before; held-out P(o) and kl_other at every checkpoint
measurements.read_side: lift.read_side_overlaps of delta-W at every checkpoint: in_alive = the share of ||delta-W||_F^2 whose read side lies in the alive read span (a random read side gives r_v / d_in), pooled by energy over the non-saturated matrices

predictions.predicted: pass: between steps 2 and 100 A moved 3% and the ratio moved 0.04 the other way; Adam at lr 1e-3 on a factor whose gradient is B^T-weighted barely moves A once B has learned, so the read side stays random to the plateau
predictions.reported: ratio, pooled in_alive and |cos| at every checkpoint; per-matrix in_alive against r_v / d_in

predictions.arm: LoRA lift at step 10 (the fine-tune's matched step)
predictions.null: Pile PGD ratio >= 5 (fragile like the fine-tune's lift: round 5's C2m direction was the step, not the update)
predictions.pass: Pile PGD ratio <= 2 and e_delta <= 0.2 (the lifted LoRA state survives the adversary where the fine-tune's lift reads 5.41)
predictions.predicted: pass: at step 2 the LoRA's update was already twice the fine-tune's step-10 update in relative norm and its lift read 1.13, so the fine-tune lift's fragility is not the update's size; what the LoRA's lift leaves in Delta is the random-read part, and the subcomponents move by what they can read
predictions.reported: the do-nothing ratio at the same step (the floor the lift is read against); the same numbers at step 100

predictions.predicted: pass, weakly: the same mechanism as P2 at an update 3-5 times larger; if P2 passes and P3 reads >= 5, the fragility is the update's size after all and arrives between steps 10 and 1000
predictions.reported: the do-nothing ratio at the plateau; Delta's share of ||delta-W||^2

reported_not_scored: P(o), kl_other, loss and relative norm per checkpoint; the per-matrix tables; the route split at the Pile steps

setup.W0: the released decomposition under round 2's Pile harness with adversary seeds (0, 1, 2)
setup.lift: lift.lift_state, Euclidean, tol 1e-6, at the Pile steps only
setup.lora: as lora_matched: rank 8 on all 24 matrices, B = 0 and A ~ N(0, 1/d_in) (seed 0), Adam lr 0.001, arm A's loss, batch 32, clip 1, 1000 steps, checkpoints (1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000); no fine-tune arm (round 5's numbers are the reference)
